## Checklist

- [ ] Docs, ADRs, `.env.example`, and skills are updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] A migration is included if the schema changed.
- [ ] No `.env`, key, token, prompt, or private data is included.
- [ ] Security implications are described below.
- [ ] I have reviewed AI-assisted changes and can explain them.
